title: GODMAN-LAUNCH — create scripts/godman-tag-all.sh to git-tag all 8 protocols
description: Create scripts/godman-tag-all.sh that reads package.json version for each of the 8 godman packages (7 protocols + SDK) and creates git tags in format 'godman-protocols/{name}@v{version}'. Supports --dry-run. This is needed before npm publish on April 14.

tasks.title: Create scripts/godman-tag-all.sh — git tag all 8 godman packages at current version
